rules.description:
HTTPX2 is now the default HTTP client, and httpx is no longer installed automatically. Applications using custom HTTPX clients, transports, or configuration objects must migrate to their HTTPX2 equivalents or use the temporary, runtime-only legacy HTTPX escape hatch.
Validation concerns: Evidence could not be verified verbatim against the source documentation.
rules.example_before:
import httpx
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(http_client=httpx.Client())
rules.example_after:
import httpx2
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(http_client=httpx2.Client())
rules.evidence:
Replace HTTPX-specific objects with the corresponding HTTPX2 objects:
Previous object
HTTPX2 object
httpx.Client
httpx2.Client
